title: Grateful Dead Live at Roosevelt Stadium on 1973-07-31
lineage: transferred by Matt Smith, mastered by Monte Barry. MAC tapes > Nak BX300 > Apogee Mini Me > Mini DAC (monitoring/mastering) > Lynx One soundcard > Wavelab 5.0 > 24/96 FLACs > Samplitude Pro 7.22 > TLH > CD Tag
source: taped by Monte Barry, Nakamichi 550 portable stereo cassette recorder, taped with Dolby NR on Maxell UD C90 normal bias cassettes, Sony ECM-99 single-point stereo mic, mic is mounted on a 12-foot pole, FOB.

ai_review.summary: A clear audience recording with solid, professional performances though the set runs unusually short.
ai_review.review: The Barry Smith audience tape offers superior clarity and instrument separation compared to other sources, making it a pleasant primary source despite some missing tunes. The show delivers professional versions of each song, but most tracks stay under ten minutes, which is atypical for this era.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers are favorable; the recording quality is praised as clear and superior, while the musical performance is described as professional though unusually concise, leading to a solid but not outstanding overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Noted for excellent separation and clarity; however, some portions of the concert are missing, requiring supplementation from other sources.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Songs are concise, with few exceeding ten minutes, which is unusual for the period but still delivered professionally.
